items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: Freddie Jenkins and George Raft and I were, we were shooting craps in a after hours place on Central Avenue

ctx.x: Well now, would this place be like the Cotton Club? Would it be patronized chiefly by white people or was the, of course it wasn't segregated?
No. Movie stars used to come there every night. George Raft, oh many.
Did this band have to play for the show and the dancing?
